variants.label: A
variants.name: Field Manual
variants.rationale: Reads like a 1944 field manual: stencil type, drab paper, one red accent.
variants.tradeoff: Can look like every other WW2 game on the shelf.
variants.satisfies: Positioning line: the hour-long Ardennes skirmish with no rulebook.

variants.label: B
variants.name: Snow Line
variants.rationale: Cold blues and white space; the winter is the brand.
variants.tradeoff: Softer than the genre expects; may read as a puzzle game.
variants.satisfies: Positioning line: the hour-long Ardennes skirmish with no rulebook.
